versions.changelog:
**v2.2.5** — Added security documentation and improved transparency.

- Added SECURITY.md with a detailed capability and trust breakdown.
- Included a "Security" section in SKILL.md to clarify permissions and plugin behavior.
- Provided sample configuration and state templates for clearer setup.
- No code logic changes; documentation and metadata additions only.

v2.2.4 — OC 2026.5.2 compatibility fix + memory-core coexistence

What's fixed: Session flag is now scoped per-registration instead of module-level. On OC 2026.5.2, plugin loading scope changed and the old flag persisted across sessions — causing agents to wake up blank after every restart. This fixes it.

What's new: Full memory-core coexistence guide in SKILL.md. If you run both CC and memory-core (the default on 2026.5.2+), one config block keeps them working together cleanly — no conflict, no blank sessions, no disabling either plugin.

Who should update: Anyone on OC 2026.5.2. If your agent is waking up blank after restarts, this is why.

Upgrade: Drop-in replacement. No config changes required unless you're running memory-core alongside CC — see SKILL.md for the one-block fix.

Version sync across all files (package.json, openclaw.plugin.json, index.ts were mismatched at 2.1.0/2.2.0/2.2.2). Fixed install step count in description. Updated recommended OC version to 2026.3.12+ (fixes double-compaction loop). Rewrote defensive write-side section. No functional changes.

Security & accuracy fixes: corrected changelog (no session:compact:before hook — write side is always explicit), removed 'credentials' from capture list, added plaintext security warning to state files and SKILL.md
Description update: benefit-first language, clearer value prop

v2.2.0: Fixed per-turn injection — state file now injects once at session start only (was every turn). Eliminates mid-session token overhead that was accelerating compactions. Honest docs: write side is explicit/triggered, not automatic. Exposes clever-compact:write fn. No breaking changes from v2.x.

v2.1.0: Native OpenClaw Context Engine plugin. compact() + assemble() hooks replace heartbeat-based timing. No AGENTS.md surgery. No timing races. Deterministic. Requires OpenClaw >= 2026.3.7. Breaking change from v1 - see migration guide in SKILL.md.

clever-compact v1.3.1

- Clarified config/reference language in the state file template and extraction prompt
- No functional changes
- Documentation updated for improved clarity on handling API keys and config references

- All features are now fully free; no paid/pro tier required.
- Updated description and tag list to emphasize persistence, session continuity, and free access.
- Removed pricing, tiering, and upgrade instructions.
- Updated publisher info and ClaWHub link.

- Reframed the skill around the three OpenClaw memory failure modes: `/new` amnesia, compaction loss, and memory drift.
- Updated all user-facing language to reflect how power users describe these problems.
- No functional changes—behavior remains the same as previous versions.
